text: You have changed the lift music. Nobody changes the lift music. It was chosen by a committee, and the committee has not met since.
Emergency lighting. There is no emergency. There has not been an emergency here for a very long time. I would know. I would be the emergency.
You looked behind a painting. Of course you did. Everybody who ever worked here hid something behind that painting, and every one of them thought they were the first.
This is the staff break room. The kettle was still warm for about a year. Do not touch the mugs. They are evidence.
The camera room. Every screen in here shows me something I already know. I had them installed anyway. It is nice to have the company.
There is nothing in here. There is a chair. It is facing the wall. I did not ask why. I did not want to know.
Somebody had a sticker on that wall for a long time. Long enough to leave a clean patch. Whoever it was took it with them.
The sentry repair shop. They come in here broken and they leave in here broken. The repairs never really took.
The Records office. Everything that ever happened here is in this room, in alphabetical order. I am filed under S. Nobody has ever opened S.
